Q1.why: The comment stays at the same column when the scalar value shrinks and when the roomy flow list grows to [a, b, c]. It only shifts where there was no padding to absorb the longer value.
When the roomy flow list grows to [a, b, c], the old padding is kept unchanged, so the comment moves 3 columns right. Scalar values keep their column.
